# Stage R12 build: the numbers (generated by `scripts/r12-runs.ts numbers`; do not edit)

Every number below is read from the run files under `artifacts/r12/` (M1: seed 48 at e38ea8c7, seed 7 at e38ea8c7; M2: 24 runs). Registration: `docs/staging/r12-build-prereg.md` (with amendment A1). **No model was run and nothing was trained.** M1 is a world in which every animal is on the rules ("no model: the rules"), read by a tap; M2 runs the two-call loop with control kernels ("no model: the rules' top option on the R12 menu", "no model: a random chooser on the R12 menu", and the wiring check's fake odds). These describe the instrument, not behaviour, and are compared with no field figure; nothing here is about wild chimpanzees.

## M1: a rules world read by a tap

### The labels of the new target stages against the rules' realised picks

At fresh rules decisions whose pick was a pant-grunt (the greeting group) or an adult male's grooming of an adult male (the grooming group at level 2), with a group of two or more: whether the pick is in the group, whether the teacher's arithmetic with the realised jitter (the published clamp of raw value plus jitter) ranks it first, whether the label (2,000 redraws of the jitter) ranks it first, and the label's mean mass on it against chance (one over the group's size). The rules pick the dominant to greet by its score before the jitter, and the grooming partner among settled partners only, so neither agreement is expected to be complete.

| | seed 48 | seed 7 |
|---|---|---|
| greeting: decisions; pick in the group; first by the realised jitter; first by the label; label mass on it (chance) | 201; 201; 181; 199; 0.840 (0.429) | 402; 402; 346; 395; 0.812 (0.389) |
| grooming among adult males: decisions; pick in the group; first by the realised jitter; first by the label; label mass on it (chance) | 122; 122; 115; 113; 0.902 (0.357) | 161; 161; 152; 148; 0.895 (0.347) |

### The hand rules the rulings keep (counted)

List `data/r12-hand-rules.json`, hash fe0607eacd145314 (157 rules: table 123; menu 16; loop 15; inside offer() 3). On the path of an animal a kernel decides for, under the runs at level 1's parameters (resourceTargets 1, menuPossible 1): **155 hand rules**.

- By status: kept 140; limit 5; rules 5; body 3; pair 2.
- By ruling: none 90; ruling 9 24; ruling 8 16; ruling 10 13; ruling 7 8; ruling 2 7; ruling 6 7; ruling 3 3; ruling 4 3; ruling 5 3.
- By class: ADVICE 93; number 30; QUOTA OR TIMER 28; DICE 3; hand-set text 1.
- Cut on the model's path by a switch that is on (still counted, off the path): only the four trees the rules value most are offered (the trip shortlist: a ranking by the rules' own value) (resourceTargets); of the dominants in reach, only the one the rules score highest is offered (alpha, displaying, nearer score more) (menuPossible).
